product.description: Indio™ by Monoprice™              Offset OS20 Classic Electric Guitar with Gig Bag              Classic "offset" design, modernized with a humbucker and two single‑coil pickups                  From cult classic to contemporary indie rock mainstream, offset body guitars remain among the coolest of designs, even decades after their inception. Originally meant as genre specific instruments, "offsets" crossed musical boundaries to regain popularity in the 21st century. Indio™ Offset OS20 Classic Guitars honor the history of offsets by combining their timeless style with Indio's unmatched value.                                    Classic "offset" body design          Bridge humbucker pickup and two single‑coil pickups          Traditional fixed, hard‑tailed bridge and tremolo                                      Maple neck with rosewood fretboard          Bolt‑on construction          648mm scale length                                                                                                                      TWO SINGLE‑COIL PICKUPS AND A HUMBUCKER                                                          Unlike the design that inspired the original Indio™ Offset guitars, the OS20 models feature a more contemporary pickup configuration, with a humbucker in the bridge position and two single‑coil pickups in the middle and neck positions. This pickup configuration gives Indio Offset OS20 Classic Guitars a wider range of possible tones, adapting to demands of contemporary players, while combining the best of both worlds. All pickups on Indio Offset OS20 Classics feature ceramic magnets.                                                                                                                                            SUPERIOR MATERIALS AND CONSTRUCTION                                                          Like all other Indio™ guitars, Offset OS20 Classics are made to deliver the specs and playability of other guitars costing several times the price. Featuring a maple neck, rosewood fretboard, and a basswood body, OS20s play and look like brand name instruments without any compromise in tone.                                                              VINTAGE STYLING              Offset OS20 Classic Guitars feature the same timeless and unconventional style that made "offsets" unique, remaining relevant through the decades since they were first introduced.
